observations.label: Confirmed contingent and quasi-fiscal exposures

Separately the ministry plans PT SMI on-lending to regional governments repaid from revenue-sharing transfers.

observations.label: Governing coalition continuity

Nazara is a career technocrat; Bloomberg described Purbaya's unorthodox spending push as having unsettled investors. Recorded as evidence; no V3 driver moved this week, and the case for a dedicated cabinet-stability driver is flagged as a methodology decision.

observations.label: Institutional checks event pool
observations.summary: Bank Indonesia governor Perry Warjiyo resigned roughly two years before his term ended. Senior Deputy Governor Destry Damayanti took over in an acting capacity from the 26 July board meeting and the government confirmed the resignation on 27 July, citing personal reasons. A fixed term is the only institutional device insulating the central bank, so an unexplained early exit voids that device in practice. A permanent successor still needs parliamentary approval, so capture is not yet an accomplished fact. Only capture and independence events contribute here; macro outcomes do not.

observations.label: Offline mobilisation event pool
observations.summary: Five consecutive days of protest 2026-08-27 to 08-31: nationwide demonstrations over the delayed asset-forfeiture bill, 322 arrests and one death in Jakarta on 08-28, a riot outside the parliament building on 08-29 with hundreds detained. The person killed belonged to the civil group GRIB Jaya, so this is no longer student-only. Still short of a regime-change demand and materially smaller than the August 2025 wave (10 dead, 3,000+ arrested); 08-27 was that wave's first anniversary.

observations.label: Online grievance proxy
observations.summary: Street heat kept receding (46.3 to 38.2, now below the pre-riot 43.2) but total opposition jumped 36.8 to 51.1 percent, crossing into the 40-55 band for the first time, with all three sides rising together and the public-vs-media gap narrowing to 9pp. Media-side opposition more than doubled in the week of the finance-minister replacement, the Whoosh debt takeover and Rp 3.36 trillion of foreign net selling.
